formula: =IF(COUNT([1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › 4–5, good],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › 3, >5],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › Disease])<3,"",IF(SUM([1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › 4–5, good],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › 3, >5],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › Disease])=20,"OK",SUM([1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › 4–5, good],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › 3, >5],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Leaf Stage (No.) › Disease])&" of "&20))
name: Leaf stage check

formula: =IF(COUNT([1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Healthy],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Medium],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Wilt])<3,"",IF(SUM([1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Healthy],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Medium],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Wilt])=20,"OK",SUM([1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Healthy],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Medium],[1 · Transplant (0 DAT) › Seedling Health / Vigor (No.) › Wilt])&" of "&20))
name: Health check

formula: =IF(OR([2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › Plant Survival (No.) › Live plant]="",COUNT([2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › New Growth (No.) › Upright plants],[2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › New Growth (No.) › Uneven / Wilt])<2),"",IF(SUM([2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › New Growth (No.) › Upright plants],[2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › New Growth (No.) › Uneven / Wilt])=[2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › Plant Survival (No.) › Live plant],"OK",SUM([2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › New Growth (No.) › Upright plants],[2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › New Growth (No.) › Uneven / Wilt])&" of "&[2 · Establishment (7 DAT) › Plant Survival (No.) › Live plant]))

formula: =IF(COUNT([5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Upright],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Mixed],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Different])<3,"",IF(SUM([5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Upright],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Mixed],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Different])=50,"OK",SUM([5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Upright],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Mixed],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Orientation (No.) › Different])&" of "&50))

formula: =IF(COUNT([5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › True-to-type],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › Variability],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › Off-type])<3,"",IF(SUM([5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › True-to-type],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › Variability],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › Off-type])=50,"OK",SUM([5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › True-to-type],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › Variability],[5 · Fruit set (60 DAT) › Fruit Shape (No.) › Off-type])&" of "&50))

formula: =IF(COUNT([7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Green],[7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Turning],[7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Red])<3,"",IF(SUM([7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Green],[7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Turning],[7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Red])=50,"OK",SUM([7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Green],[7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Turning],[7 · Maturity (75 DAT+) › Fruit Color (No.) › Red])&" of "&50))

formula: =IF(OR([8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Marketable Fruit (kg) › Total]="",[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Marketable Fruit (kg) › Marketable]=""),"",IF([8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Marketable Fruit (kg) › Marketable]<=[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Marketable Fruit (kg) › Total],"OK","More than total"))

formula: =IF(COUNT([8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Pest damage],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Disease],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Too small],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Deformed],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Rot],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Color reject])<6,"",SUM([8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Pest damage],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Disease],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Too small],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Deformed],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Rot],[8 · Harvest (75–150 DAT) › Rejected (kg) › Color reject]))

formula: =IF(OR([10 · End of Cycles › Harvested]="",[10 · End of Cycles › Total plant]="",[10 · End of Cycles › Total plant]=0),"",[10 · End of Cycles › Harvested]/[10 · End of Cycles › Total plant])
